about.title: About Us
paras: Ravindra Medical Research University (RMRU) is a centre of excellence dedicated to medical education, biomedical research and community service. The university brings together a broad spectrum of health-science programmes under one academic roof, fostering collaboration between disciplines.

Our campus offers modern lecture theatres, research laboratories, a simulation skills centre, a digital library and residential facilities, creating an environment where students learn, discover and grow.
Guided by values of integrity, compassion and scholarship, RMRU aims to produce healthcare professionals and scientists who are competent, ethical and socially responsive.

vision.title: Vision & Mission
vision.vision: To be a globally respected university for medical education and research, transforming health through knowledge, innovation and compassion.
mission: Deliver high-quality, competency-based education in health sciences.
Promote translational and interdisciplinary biomedical research.
Instil ethics, professionalism and social responsibility in every graduate.
Engage with communities to improve health awareness and outcomes.

admission.title: Admission

steps.d: Review programme-wise eligibility and the qualifying entrance examination.
Create your profile and fill in the application on the admission portal.
Participate in counselling or selection as per the notification.
Report with original documents for verification.
Pay the prescribed fee only after confirmation of your seat.

admission.notice: No payment is due before provisional allotment and document verification by the university.

research.title: Research
paras: RMRU promotes research that addresses health challenges of the region and the world. The Central Research Laboratory provides shared access to molecular biology, microscopy, cell culture and analytical instruments.
Students and faculty are supported through seed grants, research methodology training, statistical consultation and an Institutional Ethics Committee.

citizen.title: Citizen Charter
items: Provide quality, ethical and inclusive medical education.
Respond to student and public queries within 7 working days.
Publish admission, examination and fee information transparently.
Welcome feedback through the grievance and contact channels.
